# LedgerAI

> LedgerAI is an AI-native personal finance copilot. It connects a user's
> banks and email inbox, automatically syncs and categorizes every
> transaction, and turns that data into budgets, cash-flow forecasts, and a
> conversational AI coach that can answer questions about a user's own
> spending.

LedgerAI is a solo/portfolio project, open source, built with Next.js 15,
React 19, Prisma + Neon Postgres, Inngest for background jobs, and the
Anthropic Claude API for the AI coach. It is not a company or a commercial
product — it is a working demonstration of a production-shaped fintech
application (CI/CD, observability, security hardening, documented
deployment/incident-response process).

## Core features

- Bank and email account syncing (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo) via an async,
  retryable background job pipeline
- Automatic transaction categorization and merchant normalization
- Budgets, goals, and recurring-transaction detection
- Cash-flow forecasting
- An AI coach that answers natural-language questions about the user's own
  transaction history
- Document/receipt upload with OCR extraction
